articles.title: 5 states hold primaries today. And, Spokane police arrest man connected to wildfire

articles.title: Authorities arrest an arson suspect in connection with wildfires in Spokane

articles.title: Nauru, the world's 3rd-smallest country, changes its name to Naoero
